name: Bec

attributes.attribute: name meaning small, borne by several Irish heroes
father of the maiden guardians of a magical well
diviner who answered three questions at once
gained wisdom from the spilled well water

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text:
Bec is an Irish hero. The name means "small." Several figures in Irish legend bear this title. Each is a minor hero of the cycle.

One is Bec mac Buain. He was the father of the maidens who guarded a magical well. The hero Fionn Mac Cumhaill gained wisdom there. A girl accidentally spilled some water into his mouth. The spill passed on the well's power.

Another is Bec mac Bé, a diviner. His skill let him answer nine questions in a single reply. One answer settled all nine at once.

okr.objective: Capture the Irish hero Bec, a name shared by guardians and a diviner in legend.
key_results: The name Bec means small and is borne by several heroes.
Bec mac Buain fathered the maidens who guarded the magical well.
Fionn Mac Cumhaill gained wisdom from the spilled well water.
Bec mac Dé answered many questions in a single reply.
